question: Which original mouse specimens support native panel accessibility readouts at 50, 79 and 102 days with within-cohort controls, and what region- and barcode-level coverage is achieved?
decision: Qualify mouse specimen metadata, sufficient native depth, technical suffixes and credible original controls for a later analysis, then stop at Stage 1.
strongest_rival: Selection of 63 sites, tissue and culture composition, shared technical runs, missing or ambiguous samples, variable depth and lack of independent state labels can restrict an eventual comparison.
discriminator: Use the complete label-preserving fragment scan, unzoomed source map rows, measurement-specific barcode FASTQ prefixes, validated DNA index dictionary and nominal specimen manifest to distinguish real biological donors, duplicate pools, unresolved or colliding barcode suffixes and missing controls.
exposure_record: Original paper, Table 6 binding interpretation, S0-S6 and deposit review were known. Stage 1 examines presence, units, depth and missingness. No association or between-arm effect was inspected or estimated.
biological_unit: Native ATAC and tissue methylation use mice, separate organoid methylation uses source-labelled mouse lines. Binding uses paired sequences with one library per protein condition. Reads, CpGs, loci, barcodes and technical pools are nested observations.
nesting_and_overlap: Deduplicate shared specimen/donor accessions across technical records. Do not pool tissue and organoid cohorts. Full and extended ATAC exports are distinct technical sources, with original within-cohort controls preferred.
population_and_selection: All original main and extended dataset specimens and every observed fragment barcode. Independently of target signal, include uniquely DNA-assigned and pool-supported barcodes. Use min 1, 300 (working), 500 observed autosomal fragments per barcode. Return every panel region, including zero counts and unannotated regions.
contrast: Availability of deposited late recovered versus concurrent native controls in each source cohort. Main series controls retained as different-batch references only. No stage effects, site associations or between-sample comparisons of normalized signal.
endpoint: Exact raw barcode assignments and ambiguities, technical prefix and same-map duplicate records, independent nominal and usable donors, global library depth and overlap/fragment ends per native region. Presence and sufficiency of independent state labels assessed separately in the ledger.
methods: Read each four-round literal barcode, translating well numbers with the archived SHARE dictionary; normalize punctuation only. Inspect the full submitted map across relevant pools. Require one specimen and exact measurement-pool compatibility based on original FASTQ headers. Rescue validated suffix-only cores on matching technical library and donor. Hold suffixed core collisions from primary depth to prevent alias double-counting; preserve candidate and assigned biological IDs. No cross-export merge. The documented P1_62-2 example was located structurally before this freeze. Per donor use coverage tiers of at least 1, 300 and 500 actual unique autosomal fragments per barcode; these are not the original singlet QC. Denominator is sum of unique autosomal fragments of retained barcodes. Panel table keeps unique overlapping fragments and counts of native endpoints at start/end-1, without extra Tn5 shifts. State and original author scores require independent annotations. Source fragment row multiplicity retained separately from depth.
missingness_and_exclusions: Zero native fragments in a covered donor-window is a measured zero. No usable donor yields missing panel counts with zero denominator. Unannotated FOX/composite windows are inapplicable. Map ambiguity, unverified technical prefix, unsupported suffix and independent state labels remain explicit. Keep every nominal animal.
multiplicity: No tests, effect estimates, outcome selection or rankings. Retain all 63 intervals and all original samples including unavailable cases.
precision_basis: Technical coverage and presence only. No biological precision or power estimated.
interpretation_limit: Source qualification does not identify cellular state, occupancy, retained protein, methylation causality, biochemical interaction strength or change after exposure.
stop_rule: Fail on conflicting specimen-to-donor identity, barcode join row multiplication, empty technical provenance, unexplained geometry or inconsistent denominators. Report limited control groups as such. Stop for owner review before any effect or association.
amendment_reason: Owner-requested source and coverage qualification after S6. Separate Stage 1 metadata receipt.
